title: Siege of Pärnu
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Pärnu", at revision 1373819353, opens: "The siege of Pärnu took place between February 28 and March 2, 1609 during the Polish–Swedish War (1600–1611)." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4110458, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1609 military conflict in Estonia during Polish-Swedish War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
